description: Ascend-first optimization patterns used by the competition harness. Patterns are hypotheses, never automatic correctness-preserving rewrites.

common.title: Balance logical work across physical cores
signals: usedCoreNum is far below available cores

common.title: Reduce scalar/control work in hot loops
actions: replace repeated quotient/remainder with incremental indices
use tiling keys or specialization only for common stable modes

common.title: Improve memory locality and on-chip reuse

patterns.title: Overlap CopyIn/CopyOut with Vector compute
signals: MTE and V have visible idle gaps
CopyIn -> Compute -> CopyOut is effectively serial
actions: increase queue depth to 2 when UB allows
schedule next CopyIn while current tile computes and previous tile copies out

patterns.title: Use aligned DataCopy fast paths
signals: all tiles use padding copy APIs
actions: use normal DataCopy for aligned full tiles
reserve DataCopyPad for actual tails/non-aligned regions

patterns.title: Reuse UB operands and accumulators
signals: operand copied more than once per logical tile
actions: initialize accumulators from the first real operand when numerically legal

patterns.title: Optimize reduction schedule without losing precision contract
actions: consider pairwise/tree reduction only if tolerance permits

cube.canonical_flow: GM -> L1 -> L0A/L0B -> Cube -> L0C -> FixPipe -> GM/L1

patterns.title: Choose Cube-friendly tile shapes
signals: many tiny or ragged M/N/K tiles

patterns.title: Pipeline matrix data movement with Cube compute
actions: ping-pong L1/L0 staging where API permits
prefetch next tile while current Cube instruction runs

mixed_cv.canonical_flow: Cube and Vector stages exchange tiles/workspace while independent stages overlap

patterns.title: Run Cube and Vector as an overlapped producer-consumer pipeline
signals: Cube waits for Vector or Vector waits for Cube
producer and consumer operate on different tiles
actions: pipeline C(tile n+1) with V(tile n)
use event synchronization only on true data dependencies
separate workspace slots so producer does not wait for consumer to release the same buffer

patterns.title: Increase workspace ring depth to remove false C/V dependencies
signals: both Cube and Vector have gaps despite similar stage time
two-slot workspace causes producer reuse waits
actions: evaluate 2-slot versus deeper ring such as 4 slots
measure gap reduction rather than assuming more buffers help

patterns.title: Tune AIC/AIV work ratio for asymmetric Cube/Vector load
signals: Cube has idle capacity while Vector queues
AIC/AIV stage times are strongly asymmetric
actions: rebalance partitioning based on measured stage time

patterns.title: Fuse post-processing without materializing intermediates
signals: Cube result is written to GM then immediately read by Vector
actions: keep intermediate on-chip or in workspace closest to consumer when legal
